%@ meta id=railway_rescheduling family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway Timetable Rescheduling with Flexible Measures
%@ desc :: A Mixed Integer Linear Programming model to minimize passenger delays by integrating flexible stopping, flexible short-turning, retiming, reordering, and cancelling in railway operations.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Platforms.
%@ param d shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Scheduled departure time from station.
%@ param a shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Scheduled arrival time at station.
%@ param p_demand shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_count :: Time-dependent passenger demand.
%@ param cap shape=P kind=scalar domain=platform_capacity :: Platform capacity.
%@ var x shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=stop_decision lo=- hi=- :: Decision to stop at station.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=short_turn_decision lo=- hi=- :: Decision to short-turn at station.
%@ var z shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=cancellation_decision lo=- hi=- :: Decision to cancel train.
%@ var w shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=retiming_decision lo=- hi=- :: Retiming decision.
%@ var u shape=P,T domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=platform_assignment lo=- hi=- :: Assignment of train to platform.
%@ obj sense=min name=passenger_delays combination=sum :: Minimize passenger delays.
%@ con stop_capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure platform capacity for stopping trains.
%@ con short_turn kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure short-turning constraints.
%@ con cancellation kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure cancellation constraints.
%@ con retiming kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure retiming constraints.
%@ con platform_assignment kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure platform assignment constraints.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} p\_demand_{t,s} \cdot (w_{t,s} + x_{t,s} \cdot (d_{t,s} - a_{t,s})) \tag{passenger\_delays} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} u_{p,t} \le cap_{p} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{stop\_capacity} \\
  & y_{t,s} \le x_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{short\_turn} \\
  & z_{t} \le 1 - x_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{cancellation} \\
  & w_{t,s} \ge 0 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{retiming} \\
  & u_{p,t} \le x_{t,s} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{platform\_assignment} \\
\end{align}

%@ meta id=railway_rescheduling family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway Timetable Rescheduling with Flexible Stopping and Short-Turning
%@ desc :: A Mixed Integer Linear Programming model for railway timetable rescheduling with flexible stopping, flexible short-turning, retiming, reordering, and cancelling to minimize passenger delays.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Platforms.
%@ param d shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Scheduled departure time from station.
%@ param a shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Scheduled arrival time at station.
%@ param p_demand shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_count :: Time-dependent passenger demand.
%@ param cancel_cost shape=T kind=vector domain=passenger_delay :: Cost of cancelling a train.
%@ param delay_cost shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_delay :: Cost of passenger delay.
%@ param stop_cost shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_delay :: Cost of skipping or adding a stop.
%@ param short_turn_cost shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_delay :: Cost of short-turning at a station.
%@ param platform_capacity shape=S,P kind=matrix domain=platform_count :: Platform capacity at each station.
%@ var x shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=stop_decision lo=- hi=- :: Decision to stop or skip a station.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=short_turn_decision lo=- hi=- :: Decision to short-turn at a station.
%@ var z shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=cancel_decision lo=- hi=- :: Decision to cancel a train.
%@ var t shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=departure_time lo=- hi=- :: Actual departure time from station.
%@ var w shape=S,P domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=platform_assignment lo=- hi=- :: Assignment of a train to a platform.
%@ obj sense=min name=minimize_passenger_delays combination=sum :: Minimize passenger delays.
%@ con train_departure kind=scheduling domain=timetable :: Ensure trains depart according to the rescheduled timetable.
%@ con train_arrival kind=scheduling domain=timetable :: Ensure trains arrive according to the rescheduled timetable.
%@ con platform_assignment kind=assignment domain=platform :: Ensure each train is assigned to a platform.
%@ con platform_capacity kind=capacity domain=platform :: Ensure platform capacity is not exceeded.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} p\_demand_{t,s} \cdot (t_{t,s} - d_{t,s}) + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} stop\_cost_{t,s} \cdot (1 - x_{t,s}) + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} short\_turn\_cost_{t,s} \cdot y_{t,s} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} cancel\_cost_{t} \cdot z_{t} \tag{minimize\_passenger\_delays} \\
  & t_{t,s} \ge d_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{train\_departure} \\
  & t_{t,s} \le a_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{train\_arrival} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} w_{s,p,t} \le platform\_capacity_{s,p} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{platform\_capacity} \\
  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} w_{s,p,t} = 1 \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{platform\_assignment} \\
  & x_{t,s} \le w_{s,p,t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{train\_stop} \\
  & y_{t,s} \le 1 - x_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{train\_short\_turn} \\
  & z_{t} \le 1 - \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} x_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{train\_cancel} \\
\end{align}

%@ meta id=railway_rescheduling family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway Timetable Rescheduling with Flexible Stopping and Short-Turning
%@ desc :: A Mixed Integer Linear Programming model to minimize passenger delays by integrating flexible stopping, flexible short-turning, retiming, reordering, and cancelling.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Platforms.
%@ param d shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Scheduled arrival time of train at station.
%@ param p shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_demand :: Time-dependent passenger demand for train at station.
%@ param c shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=delay_cost :: Cost of delay for train at station.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=large_number :: Large number for big-M formulation.
%@ var x shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=stopping lo=- hi=- :: 1 if train stops at station, 0 otherwise.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=short_turning lo=- hi=- :: 1 if train short-turns at station, 0 otherwise.
%@ var z shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=cancelling lo=- hi=- :: 1 if train is cancelled, 0 otherwise.
%@ var t shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=retiming lo=- hi=- :: Actual arrival time of train at station.
%@ var u shape=S,P domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=platform_assignment lo=- hi=- :: 1 if platform is assigned to station, 0 otherwise.
%@ obj sense=min name=passenger_delays combination=sum :: Minimize passenger delays.
%@ con stopping kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure train stops or short-turns at each station.
%@ con short_turning kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure short-turning train does not stop at subsequent stations.
%@ con cancelling kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure cancelled train does not stop at any station.
%@ con retiming kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure actual arrival time is within scheduled time window.
%@ con platform kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure each train serving a station is assigned a platform.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} c_{t,s} \cdot (t_{t,s} - d_{t,s}) \cdot x_{t,s} \tag{passenger\_delays} \\
  & x_{t,s} + y_{t,s} \le 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{stopping} \\
  & y_{t,s} + \sum_{s' \in \mathcal{S}, s' > s} x_{t,s'} \le 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{short\_turning} \\
  & z_{t} + \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} x_{t,s} \le 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{cancelling} \\
  & t_{t,s} \ge d_{t,s} - M \cdot (1 - x_{t,s}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{retiming} \\
  & t_{t,s} \le d_{t,s} + M \cdot (1 - x_{t,s}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{retiming} \\
  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} u_{s,p} \ge \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} x_{t,s} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{platform} \\
  & \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} u_{s,p} \le 1 \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{platform} \\
\end{align}
